## What already works

The test suite reached an F1 score of 0.82 on the sample set, and the last release shipped in Q3. See also [Pin the model](#s1-pin-the-model).

### S1: Pin the model

**What we saw.** The config names no model version.

**Why it matters.** The README says the cache "must be cleared before each run", and results differ when it is not.

**Source.** [config.yml](https://github.com/acme/tools/blob/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567/config.yml)

**Suggested change.** Try naming one version in the config.

# Review of queue design

This is a read of your design doc. The [rating](#rating) is below the table.

- Two fixes are suggested.
- Please report back on which one helps.

| ID | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| S1 | State the retry limit |
| S2 | Name the owner |

## Rating

| Area | Rating |
| --- | --- |
| Execution | Good |
| Fit | Good |
| Coverage | Fair |
| Evidence | Weak |

## What already works

The doc explains the queue flow clearly, and a sample run with a score of 0.9 is shown. See [Name the owner](#s2-name-the-owner).

### S1: State the retry limit

**What we saw.** The doc says failed jobs retry but gives no limit.

**Why it matters.** Readers cannot tell when a job stops retrying.

**Source.** [design doc](https://example.com/design/queue-v2#retries)

**Suggested change.** Try adding one sentence with the maximum retry count.

**How to check it.** Ask three readers for the limit and count how many answer the same. Tell me what you find.

### S2: Name the owner

**What we saw.** No section names who runs the queue.

**Why it matters.** Questions about failures have no clear first contact.

**Source.** [design doc](https://example.com/design/queue-v2#ops)

**Suggested change.** Consider adding an owner line to the ops section.

**How to check it.** Reread the ops section and see whether it passes the test of naming one person. Let me know.
note: Tell me whether the retry question is already settled elsewhere.
why: Design doc using target and no repo; two fixes; all rules met.
